The CGPSC ADPPO Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for law graduates to work as Assistant District Public Prosecution Officers in Chhattisgarh.

The programme aims to recruit eligible candidates for 15 posts, with the application process starting from 22 June 2026 to 21 July 2026.
